paragraphs.en: Typhoon Champi brought destructive winds and heavy rains to Taiwan, causing extensive damage and leading many cities and counties to cancel work and classes. The Central Weather Administration (CWA) reported that the storm, which was once a super typhoon, generated gusts of about 191 kilometers per hour near its center. Several local governments, including Taipei, New Taipei City, Taoyuan, and Taichung, declared a second consecutive typhoon day, while mountainous regions prepared for intense downpours.
paragraphs.zh: 薔琵颱風為臺灣帶來具破壞性的強風與豪雨，造成廣泛的損害，並導致許多縣市停班停課。中央氣象署（CWA）報告指出，這場曾一度為強烈颱風的風暴，其中心附近出現時速約191公里的陣風。包括臺北市、新北市、桃園市及臺中市在內的數個地方政府宣布連續第二天放颱風假，同時山區也為劇烈暴雨預作準備。

paragraphs.en: According to the CWA, the storm was located approximately 100 kilometers east of Yilan yesterday evening, packing maximum sustained winds of 155 kilometers per hour. Forecaster Liu Pei-teng pointed out that the typhoon possessed an unusually large wind radius. Although projected tracks indicated that Champi would head toward the Chinese coast and southern Japan, forecasters warned that landfall remained possible if the storm "stalls, loops or wobbles from side to side" near the island. Meanwhile, rainfall at the Taipingshan weather station in Yilan exceeded 500 millimeters.
paragraphs.zh: 根據中央氣象署的資料，該風暴昨晚位於宜蘭東方約100公里處，最大持續風速達到每小時155公里。預報員劉沛滕指出，該颱風擁有異常龐大的暴風半徑。儘管預測路徑顯示薔琵將朝中國沿海及日本南部移動，但氣象預報員警告，若風暴在接近臺灣時「停滯、打轉或左右擺動」，仍有可能登陸。同時，宜蘭太平山測站的累積雨量已超過500毫米。

paragraphs.en: The severe weather has resulted in casualties and infrastructure problems across the nation. The Central Emergency Operations Center confirmed that one man died in Pingtung County after being swept away by rough waves, and 350 other people were injured. To protect residents, rescue workers evacuated more than 2,600 people from vulnerable mountainous areas. Furthermore, Taiwan Power Company stated that over 77,000 households lost power, although electricity was restored to more than 75 percent of them by the afternoon.
paragraphs.zh: 嚴峻的天氣已在全臺造成人員傷亡與基礎設施問題。中央災害應變中心證實，屏東縣有一名男子遭大浪捲走後身亡，另有350人受傷。為了保護居民，搜救人員已從脆弱的山區撤離了超過2,600人。此外，台灣電力公司表示有超過7萬7千戶停電，不過下午已有超過百分之75的用戶恢復供電。

paragraphs.en: Transportation nationwide suffered severe disruptions. The Civil Aviation Administration reported that all 262 domestic flights and 715 international flights were canceled yesterday. In addition, ferry operators suspended maritime travel due to hazardous sea conditions. Because flight and ferry schedules remained uncertain, officials urged passengers to check the latest updates before departing for airports or harbors.
paragraphs.zh: 全國各地的交通遭受嚴重中斷。民航局報告指出，昨天所有262架次國內線航班及715架次國際線航班均被取消。此外，由於危險的海況，渡輪營運商暫停了海上運輸。由於航班與渡輪時刻表仍充滿不確定性，官員呼籲旅客在出發前往機場或港口前先確認最新消息。

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 由關係代名詞 which 引導非限定關係子句，前後以逗號隔開，用來補充說明先行詞 the storm 的額外資訊。
grammar.example: The Central Weather Administration (CWA) reported that the storm, which was once a super typhoon, generated gusts of about 191 kilometers per hour near its center.
grammar.focus: , which was once a super typhoon,

grammar.point: 條件副詞子句 (Adverbial Clause of Condition)
grammar.explain: 由從屬連接詞 if 引導條件副詞子句，用來表示在特定假設情況下可能會發生的結果。
grammar.example: Although projected tracks indicated that Champi would head toward the Chinese coast and southern Japan, forecasters warned that landfall remained possible if the storm "stalls, loops or wobbles from side to side" near the island.
grammar.focus: if the storm "stalls, loops or wobbles from side to side" near the island

grammar.point: 介系詞後接動名詞 (Gerund as the Object of a Preposition)
grammar.explain: 介系詞 before 後面接動名詞 departing，作為介系詞的受詞，表達在出發前進行某動作。
grammar.example: Because flight and ferry schedules remained uncertain, officials urged passengers to check the latest updates before departing for airports or harbors.

lessons.title: Britain's posh schools are heading to India for students and profits
lessons.title_zh: 英國貴族學校前往印度招攬學生並追求獲利

paragraphs.en: Several elite British private schools are opening new campuses across India. Earlier this year, the Bedford School opened an all-girls branch in Mohali, Punjab. Other famous historic schools, such as Harrow School in Bengaluru, Shrewsbury School in Bhopal, and Wellington College in Pune, have also established campuses in the country.
paragraphs.zh: 數所英國菁英私立學校正在印度各地開設新校區。今年稍早，貝德福德學校在旁遮普邦的莫哈利開設了一所全女子分校。其他著名且歷史悠久的學校，例如班加羅爾的哈羅公學、波帕爾的舒茲伯利學校以及浦那的威靈頓公學，也都在該國設立了校區。

paragraphs.en: This expansion is driven by challenges back home and abroad. In the UK, the government introduced a 20 percent tax on private school fees in 2025. Meanwhile, strict regulations in China, including a 2024 law demanding patriotic education, have forced British institutions to look for new international markets. Naomi Atkins, the founding principal at Bedford School Mohali, stated that "they are in a desperate situation."
paragraphs.zh: 這種擴張是由國內外的挑戰所推動的。在英國，政府於 2025 年開始對私立學校學費課徵百分之二十的稅。與此同時，中國嚴格的法規——包括一項要求實施愛國教育的 2024 年法律——已迫使英國機構尋找新的國際市場。莫哈利貝德福德學校的創校校長 Naomi Atkins 表示：「他們處於絕望的境地。」

paragraphs.en: India provides an attractive alternative because its growing economy has created many wealthy families who desire a global education for their children. These British schools offer international frameworks like the Cambridge curriculum, while mixing historic UK traditions with local Indian culture. Parents also appreciate that these institutions offer holistic development and do not give special privileges to the children of powerful officials.
paragraphs.zh: 印度提供了一個具吸引力的替代選擇，因為其成長中的經濟孕育了許多渴望讓子女接受全球化教育的富裕家庭。這些英國學校提供如劍橋課程等國際架構，同時將悠久的英國傳統與印度在地文化融合在一起。家長們也十分讚賞這些機構提供全人發展，而且不給予高官子女特殊特權。

paragraphs.en: However, succeeding in India is not simple. Local competition is fierce because English education is already well established in the country. Furthermore, Indian parents are very price-sensitive, which has led schools like Bedford Mohali to reduce their fees. Although British schools generated over 150 million pounds from overseas branches over the past decade, experts predict that their growth in India will be slow and steady.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在印度取得成功並不容易。由於英語教育在該國已根深蒂固，在地的競爭非常激烈。此外，印度家長對價格非常敏感，這導致像莫哈利貝德福德這樣的學校調降了學費。儘管英國學校在過去十年間透過海外分校創造了超過一億五千萬英鎊的獲利，但專家預測它們在印度的成長將會是緩慢而穩定的。

vocab.zh: 處於絕境的；孤注一擲的

grammar.explain: 由「be 動詞 is + 過去分詞 driven」構成現在簡單式的被動語態，表示某件事受到某些因素推動。
grammar.example: This expansion is driven by challenges back home and abroad.

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 who 作為形容詞子句的主詞，用來修飾先行詞 families，說明這些家庭的特質。
grammar.example: India provides an attractive alternative because its growing economy has created many wealthy families who desire a global education for their children.
grammar.focus: who desire a global education for their children

grammar.point: 讓步副詞子句 (Adverb Clause of Concession)
grammar.explain: 由從屬連接詞 Although 引導讓步副詞子句，表示「雖然；儘管」，用來對比主要子句的情況。
grammar.example: Although British schools generated over 150 million pounds from overseas branches over the past decade, experts predict that their growth in India will be slow and steady.
grammar.focus: Although British schools generated over 150 million pounds from overseas branches over the past decade

lessons.title: Australia offers astronaut Katherine Bennell-Pegg for space mission to International Space Station
lessons.title_zh: 澳洲提供太空人凱瑟琳·貝內爾-佩格參與國際太空站太空任務

paragraphs.en: The Australian federal government has officially offered the European Space Agency (ESA) to send astronaut Katherine Bennell-Pegg to the International Space Station (ISS) for a mission slated for the year 2028. If she successfully embarks on this journey, she will achieve a historic milestone by becoming the first space traveler to qualify under the Australian flag. Although two previous Australian-born individuals have traveled beyond Earth, they flew as citizens of the United States on missions organized by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA). Another individual recently completed a suborbital flight as a dual citizen, making this upcoming project a unique national endeavor.
paragraphs.zh: 澳洲聯邦政府已正式向歐洲太空總署（ESA）提出邀請，計畫派遣太空人凱瑟琳·貝內爾-佩格（Katherine Bennell-Pegg）前往國際太空站（ISS）執行預定於2028年的任務。如果她順利踏上這趟旅程，將創下歷史里程碑，成為第一位以澳洲國旗資格合格的太空旅行者。儘管先前有兩位出生於澳洲的人士去過地球之外，但他們是在美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）的任務中以美國公民身分飛行的。另一位人士最近則以雙重公民身分完成了一次次軌道飛行，這使得這項即將到來的計畫成為一項獨特的國家努力。

paragraphs.en: However, funding this ambitious project presents a significant financial challenge because the costs are extremely high. Science Minister Tim Ayres noted that the undertaking is too expensive for any single government to fund completely. To solve this problem, officials have actively engaged with the private sector, state governments, and generous donors to raise the required money. Generous philanthropists have already promised more than six million dollars in cash along with additional support, while several local state governments have also shown a willingness to help. In particular, South Australia has publicly committed to supporting the bid because its leaders believe the project could greatly boost the local economy and inspire students.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，由於成本極高，為這個雄心勃勃的計畫籌措資金帶來了重大的財務挑戰。科學部長提姆·艾爾斯（Tim Ayres）指出，這項事業過於昂貴，任何單一政府都無法完全資助。為了克服這個問題，官方積極與民間企業、州政府及慷慨的捐助者接洽，以籌集所需的資金。慷慨的慈善家們已經承諾提供超過六萬美元的現金以及其他支援，同時幾個地方州政府也表現出協助的意願。特別的是，南澳已公開承諾支持這項競標，因為其領導階層相信該計畫可以大幅提振當地經濟並激勵學生。

paragraphs.en: Supporters of the mission argue that sending a national representative into orbit could effectively encourage young people to pursue careers in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics. Leaders point out that the country currently faces a serious shortage of youth entering these vital technical fields, which could slow down national productivity. Furthermore, space industry experts believe that investing in this field could bring strong returns over time, comparing the expense to a down payment on future technological growth. Meanwhile, the space agency is also planning another related project involving an Australian-built lunar rover destined for the moon on a future mission.
paragraphs.zh: 該任務的支持者主張，將國家代表送入軌道可以有效地鼓勵年輕人追求科學、技術、工程和數學領域的職涯。領導人們指出，該國目前正面臨投入這些重要技術領域的年輕人嚴重短缺的問題，這可能會拖慢國家生產力。此外，太空產業專家認為，投資這個領域隨著時間能帶來強勁的回報，並將這筆開銷比喻為對未來技術成長的頭期款。同時，太空機構也正計畫另一項相關專案，內容包含一個澳洲製造的月球車，預計在未來的任務中前往月球。

grammar.explain: 用來連接子句並修飾前方名詞，說明該太空任務預定執行的時間。
grammar.example: The Australian federal government has officially offered the European Space Agency (ESA) to send astronaut Katherine Bennell-Pegg to the International Space Station (ISS) for a mission slated for the year 2028.

grammar.explain: 表示主詞承受動作，此處用來描述一項由澳洲製造的月球車將被派遣至月球。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, the space agency is also planning another related project involving an Australian-built lunar rover destined for the moon on a future mission.

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的用 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 置於句中用以說明採取某項行動的目的，在此指鼓勵年輕人追求特定領域的職涯。
grammar.example: Supporters of the mission argue that sending a national representative into orbit could effectively encourage young people to pursue careers in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics.
